title: Zetta-Joule header
description: A transparent header floating over the hero: wordmark left, seven small centred links whose text rolls up on hover, a pale-blue CTA right. On phones a white rounded menu button opens a full-width list. Slides away while scrolling down and returns going up on a dark blurred bar.
notes: it is a zero-height sticky element: place it directly above the hero
white text: made for a coloured or photographic hero
